description_full: West Coast Community Bancorp operates as the bank holding company for West Coast Community Bank that provides a range of commercial and personal banking services to residents and businesses in the United States. The company offers personal and business checking, savings, money market, health savings, and individual retirement accounts, as well as certificate of deposits; and retirement plans. It also provides business, real estate commercial property and construction, and asset-based lending; agricultural and wine industry lending products; small business administration, 504 loan program, business and industry loans, and farm services agency loans; and lines of credit. In addition, the company offers merchant services, bill payment, treasury management, remote deposit capture, debit and credit cards, merchant gift cards, courier services, lockbox, cash vault, safe deposits box, ATMs and online and mobile banking services. West Coast Community Bancorp was founded in 2004 and is headquartered in Santa Cruz, California.

financial_summary: WEST COAST COMMUNITY BANCORP is a small-cap financial services business with a $653M market cap on $139M of annual revenue.
The top line has compounded at +23% over the past three years, the kind of sustained demand persistence that marks a compounder.

The business throws off $49M in free cash flow — roughly 35 cents on every revenue dollar, which is the owner-earnings figure that actually belongs to shareholders, and cash conversion sits at 1.03× so those profits are backed by real cash.
On the balance sheet, the balance sheet carries net cash, which is the gold standard: the business never has to make desperate decisions in a bad year.
Shareholder yield of 2.6% reflects a genuine commitment to returning capital rather than empire-building, and insiders hold 3.5% of the shares.
